text:
Maya Chen: Quick check — webinar preflight is tomorrow 10am. Need final on registration UX, Zoom record settings, and post-event clip routing. Who's on green?
Alex Rivera: I'm on it. UX tweaks pushed to the reg page already (CTA button copy change + added timezone selector).
Priya Patel: Nice. Confirming email sequence: registrant, reminder 1 day, reminder 1 hour, replay with clips + TL;DR. Do we want a short survey in the replay email?
Maya Chen: Yes to survey (3 Qs). Keep it optional. Also want the clips split by segment for paid followups.
Tom Wu: Zoom settings — set to Cloud recording, "Record active speaker with shared screen" + "Record gallery" off. Separate audio tracks disabled. Auto-start recording enabled.
Alex Rivera: Uploading final Zoom config in case anyone wants the exact flags: ```{"cloud_recording": true, "auto_record": "on", "record_gallery": false, "split_clips": false}```
Priya Patel: For clip routing: post-recording, we want: 1) long-form archive to S3 -> marketing/assets/webinars/YYYYMMDD, 2) auto-transcript to Otter -> get VTT, 3) 3x short clips (30s, 60s, 120s) forwarded to ContentOps Slack channel and HubSpot asset card.
Tom Wu: I'll add a post-processing zap: Zoom -> lambda for clip split -> S3 + webhook to /content-ops. Naming convention: redwood-webinar-<YYYYMMDD>-<slug> to keep things tidy.
Maya Chen: Can we add a prefix on the reg page that autoresolves the <slug> from title? Otherwise manual work.
Alex Rivera: Done. The reg page passes `event_slug` in the Zap payload now. Example payload: `{"event_slug":"inference-benchmarks-2026"}`
Priya Patel: For lead routing, send registrant + attendance flag to HubSpot list "webinar: benchmarks" and tag as source=webinar-<slug>. Also send attended=true leads to SDR queue via webhook.
Tom Wu: I'll test the end-to-end after the rehearsal. Zoom Bot: recording will auto-upload ~5 minutes after end.
Zoom Bot: Note: Cloud recording processed time varies. Expect VTT + mp4 in 10-20 mins depending on load.
Maya Chen: Great. Final checklist: 1) Reg page ✓ 2) Email sequence ✓ 3) Zoom recording flags ✓ 4) Zap for clips ✓ 5) HubSpot mapping ✓ 6) Post-event survey in replay email ✓
Priya Patel: I'll draft the replay email with survey and clip CTAs and drop in #content-ops by EOD.
Alex Rivera: Rehearsal at 9:15 tomorrow — I'll be there to confirm recording triggers. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: Thanks all — nervous but excited. :party_parrot:
